fields.name: recipient
fields.description: The identifier of the entity receiving the notification.

fields.name: channel
fields.description: The delivery method for the notification (e.g., email, SMS, in-app).

fields.name: message
fields.description: The content of the notification message.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Indicates the importance or urgency level of the notification.

fields.name: dispatched
fields.description: Indicates whether the notification has been successfully sent.

fields.name: error
fields.description: Failure detail from the delivery service when dispatched is false (email/sms/webhook channels only).
fields.synonyms: error message, failure reason, dispatch error

fields.name: recordedAt
fields.description: Timestamp indicating when the notification record was created.

events.name: NOTIFY_EMAIL_SENT
events.description: email.send service result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor

events.name: NOTIFY_EMAIL_FAILED
events.description: email.send service call failed — dispatched lands false and error carries the service detail

events.name: NOTIFY_SMS_SENT
events.description: twilio.sendSMS service result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor

events.name: NOTIFY_SMS_FAILED
events.description: twilio.sendSMS service call failed — dispatched lands false and error carries the service detail

events.name: NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_SENT
events.description: webhook.send service result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor

events.name: NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_FAILED
events.description: webhook.send service call failed — dispatched lands false and error carries the service detail

overridableConfigKeys.label: Email subject
overridableConfigKeys.description: Subject line used for the email channel. Falls back to `template` when blank. Ignored for other channels.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: subject, subject line, email title, mail subject

overridableConfigKeys.label: Fallback recipient
overridableConfigKeys.description: Recipient used when `recipients` is empty, instead of the acting user. The acting-user fallback (used when this is blank) is intended for personal notifications only — set this to an ops/team address (e.g. 'ops@example.com') for system alerts like low-stock or shipping notices, so the acting user isn't notified in place of the intended audience.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: default recipient, backup recipient, ops address, fallback address, notify default, alert owner

overridableConfigKeys.label: Frequency cap (per week)
overridableConfigKeys.description: Max sends per (channel, recipient) per rolling 7-day window. 0 = uncapped. WIRING DEFERRED: needs stateful history query (gap — docs/Almadar_Std_Factories.md).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Guard field (numeric)
overridableConfigKeys.description: Field read from the upstream event's `data` payload and compared against `guardValue` when `guardOp` is not `eq` (e.g. 'stockLevel', 'quantity'). Ignored when `guardOp` is `eq`.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: threshold field, numeric field, compare field, watched field, data field

overridableConfigKeys.label: Guard comparison
overridableConfigKeys.description: How to gate dispatch. `eq` (default) does string-equality via `triggerStatus` against the upstream event's `status` field, exactly as before. `gt`/`lt`/`gte`/`lte` instead numerically compare `guardField` (read from the event's `data` payload) against `guardValue` — e.g. fire only when a stock level drops below a threshold.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: comparison operator, threshold operator, guard mode, trigger comparison, numeric gate, greater than, less than, threshold crossing

overridableConfigKeys.label: Guard value (numeric)
overridableConfigKeys.description: Threshold compared against `guardField` when `guardOp` is not `eq` (e.g. fire when stock drops below 5).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: threshold, cutoff, limit, watermark, trigger value

overridableConfigKeys.label: Trigger events
overridableConfigKeys.description: Event names that should fire a notification. Set this to the upstream event name (e.g. OrderPlaced, CheckoutCompleted) so this atom listens for events from the orbital that emits them. The orbital owning this trait reacts whenever the named event fires anywhere in the schema.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: subscribe to event, listen for event, react to event, watch for, wire upstream event, observe event from another orbital, cross-orbital subscription, on-event trigger

overridableConfigKeys.label: Channel
overridableConfigKeys.description: Delivery channel. `in-app` (default) emits the in-app `notify` toast — unchanged from prior versions. `email`/`sms`/`webhook` dispatch through call-service at event time (email.send / twilio.sendSMS / webhook.send) and persist a NotificationRecord audit row with an honest `dispatched` flag: true only once the service call succeeds, false plus the failure detail in `error` otherwise. `webhook` requires `webhookUrl` to actually dispatch; a blank `webhookUrl` still records the audit row undispatched rather than failing.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: delivery method, notification channel, send via, dispatch through

overridableConfigKeys.label: Quiet hours
overridableConfigKeys.description: Local-time window during which dispatch is suppressed. Both start and end required to activate. WIRING DEFERRED: needs @now-aware time comparison primitive (gap — docs/Almadar_Std_Factories.md).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Recipients
overridableConfigKeys.description: Recipient ids/addresses. v1.1 uses the first entry; multi-recipient fan-out lands in v1.2 (gap). When empty, falls back to `fallbackRecipient` if set, otherwise the authenticated user.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Severity
overridableConfigKeys.description: info, success, warning, or error — controls styling

overridableConfigKeys.label: Suppression list
overridableConfigKeys.description: Recipient ids/addresses to skip (e.g. unsubscribed users). Suppression check runs before dispatch.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Message template
overridableConfigKeys.description: Text shown to the recipient; supports payload interpolation
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: notification text, message body, alert text

overridableConfigKeys.label: Trigger status
overridableConfigKeys.description: When `guardOp` is `eq` and this is set, dispatch only when the upstream event's `status` field equals this value (e.g. fire only when a record becomes 'approved'). Empty = fire on every subscribed event. Ignored when `guardOp` is a numeric comparison.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: on status, when status, status filter, only when, fire on, react on status

overridableConfigKeys.label: Webhook secret
overridableConfigKeys.description: Signing secret forwarded to the webhook service so the receiving endpoint can verify the payload. Ignored when `webhookUrl` is blank.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: signing secret, hmac secret, webhook signature, shared secret

overridableConfigKeys.label: Webhook URL
overridableConfigKeys.description: Destination endpoint for the webhook channel. Dispatch only fires when this is non-blank; a blank URL on channel "webhook" records the audit row with dispatched:false instead of crashing (a consumer misconfiguration, not a failure).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: webhook endpoint, callback url, target url, http endpoint, notify url
